title: ALL ( table ) with VALUES ( column ) keeps the column's visible values even when it is not filtered directly
query: DEFINE MEASURE Sales[Using AllValues] = CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALL ( 'Product' ), VALUES ( 'Product'[Category] ) )

source.quote: VALUES evaluates the values of a column as visible in the current filter context, and applies the result as a filter
source.supports: VALUES returns the categories visible under the product filter (cross-filtered) and applies them as a filter after ALL removed the rest

derivation: For each product VALUES ( Product[Category] ) is evaluated under the product filter: Bike and Scooter see Vehicles, Helmet and Lock see Accessories. ALL ( Product ) removes the product filter and the category filter applies: Vehicles 400, Accessories 60 + 80 = 140. Scooter has no sales of its own but gets its category's 400.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
